note: GoF2 shop icons. atlas/rect = the variant the Android HD build loads on a >=1700x1080 screen (Globals::iPadLarge): items from gof2_items_ipad_large / gof2_items_ipad_2_large (178x86 cells), the item frames and several UI images re-bound to gof2_interface2_ipad_large, other UI from gof2_interface_iphone4. rect = [x, y, w, h] in pixels, top-left origin. base = 1x variant (gof2_items / gof2_interface, 58x28 item cells), iphone4 = 2x phone variant (116x56 item cells). Item icons are drawn on top of the frame image of their type (frameImageId), same top-left. See Reference/research/shop.md section 1.
